caveat.weather: Point d''observation — pas une grille de prévision
caveat.camera: Caméras en direct — ouvre le site de la source dans un nouvel onglet
caveat.outage: Granularité par comté (EAGLE-I) : les zones sont des estimations supposées hors service, pas des coupures confirmées par adresse.
caveat.cell: Estimation de couverture dérivée d''OpenCelliD — indicative, pas une carte de signal garantie.

anticipatory.title: Anticipatory action
anticipatory.members: {over, number} of {total, number} forecast members over {threshold, number} {unit}
anticipatory.leadTime: {hours, number} h, as stated by the source. BEACON does not model hazard travel time.
anticipatory.stageGate: Gate: at least {fraction, number} of forecast members over {threshold, number} {unit}, class {klass} or higher, within {hours, number} h lead time.
anticipatory.noEmission: Suggestions only. Nothing on this panel dispatches a resource or emits a public alert; a named human must approve every early action.
anticipatory.stopMechanism: Stop mechanism: {role} may stop the activation on a pre-agreed condition, and the engine stops it automatically after {hours, number} h.
anticipatory.replay: Fixture-fed replay: each recorded forecast run is re-evaluated {lag, number} h after the issue instant stated in the file. Not live data — BEACON queries no ensemble product at runtime.
anticipatory.noProtocolTitle: No early action protocol for this region
anticipatory.noProtocolBody: BEACON ships no early action protocol whose scope names this region, so there is nothing to evaluate. Protocols are configuration (config/eap/), not code.
anticipatory.noForecastTitle: No recorded forecast for this protocol
anticipatory.noForecastBody: The protocol ships, but no recorded forecast file ships with it, so no evaluation can be replayed. BEACON has no wired live ensemble source.
anticipatory.engineRefusedTitle: The anticipatory engine refused this input
anticipatory.engineRefusedBody: The engine refused the input rather than showing a partial evaluation.
